sections.title: Unit 16: Media Pluralism, Algorithmic Filters & Information Integrity
body: In Central Europe and Hungary, media pluralism faces unprecedented challenges: institutional consolidation (KESMA), algorithmic filter bubbles, hybrid disinformation, and state advertising dominance.

Through serialized case studies examining media ownership concentration, social media echo chambers, deepfake manipulation, Pegasus investigative revelations, and civic crowdfunding models, you will master critical media analysis in C1 Hungarian.
